title: linaria alpina subsp. propinqua
intro: Linaria alpina subsp. propinqua, commonly known as the alpine toadflax, is a flowering plant species within the Lamiaceae family. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation and fighting off infections. The health benefits of Linaria alpina subsp. propinqua are attributed to its therapeutic actions, such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can help alleviate symptoms of various conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
